subject: if-st-dy
title: IF.ST.DY.-----SOC.RT.
description: Chart on book p. 49 (SD(SY)-27). IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; SOC-RT (social reality) is the partner. From the subject: TM (terminology—or terms of a definition), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", and POL-DY (political dynamics). From TM: INFO-DY (information dynamics). From POL-DY: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and AFN (affinity negation). From INFO-DY: VT-PLT (vibrational platform). From PROG-CONT: ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics). From AFN: APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions). From VT-PLT: ACT (activism). From ACC-DY: AGT (agreement), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion". From APP-RDEF: INT (intention), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of".
